Master of Data Science

The Master of Data Science is a two-year taught program offered by the School of Computing.

Entry requirements

Applicants need a bachelor's degree in a quantitative discipline with a weighted average mark of at least 75%.

Applicants from China: a bachelor's degree with an average of 80% from a 985/211 university, or 85% from other recognised universities.

Applicants must have completed at least one course in linear algebra and one in programming.

English language

IELTS Academic: an overall score of 6.5 with no band below 6.0.

TOEFL iBT: for tests taken on or before 20 January 2026, a total of 90; for tests taken on or after 21 January 2026, a score of 4.5.

Admitted students in 2025 had an average IELTS score of 7.5.

How to apply

Applications for the 2027 intake close on 30 November 2026.

Round 2 closes on 15 January.

Tuition fee: 52,000 per year.
